title: polygala nitida var. lithophila
intro: Polygala nitida var. lithophila, commonly known as Lithophila, is a plant species in the Polygalaceae family, native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithophila include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions like arthritis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Lithophila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a promising source of natural remedies.
